title: Registry companion 1.1.0: source signature
description: Released on registry-v1.1.0 with spec/registry-1.1.0.md, which governs where they differ. A source signature document (section 10.2) (section 10), closed: exactly five string members. A document the schema refuses is refused with one code of section 11's reading order (LOCK-SIG-DOCUMENT, -VERSION, -MEMBER, -ALGORITHM, -PUBLIC-KEY or -FORM).
$comment: The reader's to check: the bound of 4096 bytes, one JSON object in UTF-8 with no member given twice and no backslash anywhere, the version member before the others, the trust rule of checkpoint-witness section 5 for publicKey, and, for a writer, the members in code-point order with no white space and one final line feed.
